title: Handmaiden's Mace

sources.title: Concussive Smash
markers: | description = Hit an enemy with all your might to deal damage and possibly {{cond|Dazed|Daze}} them.

summary: A +2 mace that sets Strength to at least 18 and adds 1d6 Poison to hits.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d6 + 2 Bludgeoning plus Strength modifier. +2 enchantment also applies to attack rolls. Simple, one-handed, 5 ft melee.
fields.Hidden Poisoned effect: On hit, the target also makes a hidden DC 12 Constitution save. On failure it is Poisoned for 2 turns, giving disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.
fields.Concussive Smash: Action once per Short Rest. Make a melee weapon attack. On hit, a Constitution save against the hybrid DC prevents Dazed for 2 turns. Dazed removes Dexterity AC bonus, gives disadvantage on Wisdom saves, and blocks actions that spend the Reaction resource.
fields.Base value: 480 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
